Explores a set list of prefix and suffix meanings, plus unscored talk about new words. It doesn’t check independent decoding, spelling or the whole topic.
Practices writing and fixing a short list of exact instructions. It is guided practice, separate from general programming skill.
Watches whether a message built from tapped cards gets the parcel to the right place, then revises it. It doesn’t check free writing or the wider topic.
Chooses one setting to change in a model ramp. It doesn’t show designing or running a real fair test alone.
Reads a results table that the app fills in. Collecting the data alone isn’t checked.
Compares the model cart on two landing surfaces. The results are drawn examples rather than real measurements.
Reads simple bar charts of model distances. Drawing graphs and reading a full data set aren’t checked.

Match a pictured animal need to damp cover or adult-butterfly nectar and reason about an explicit change. Interdependence, full basic-needs coverage and field investigation are not observed.

Writing may be supported; spelling, independence, story quality and full narrative proficiency are not assessed. The optional message-reader stage adds a character reason and reply as a narrow original-dialogue opportunity; no minimum story length.

Light slice only: inspect explicitly invented already-emerged cress seedlings under adequate versus too-little light, with supplied controls. No measured growth dataset, species-wide light rule or full plant-requirements coverage.

Copy selected finite model observations into a labelled table, preserving day, condition, specimen and millimetres. This is supplied-row collecting; independently choosing useful data, measuring and constructing charts remain planned.

Two finite model questions distinguish a pictured length from a proposed cause and compare stem length with leaf/stem features. Model observation versus interpretation practice, not a real-world causal experiment.
Choose between two supplied proposed water comparisons: hold light and other conditions alike, or confound light and water. No water results or independent experimental-design claim.

Choose up to two supplied observations relevant to a day/specimen question, retain source labels and exact units, and revise a selection. This extends copied-row collecting; no physical data gathering or measurement claim.

Table-to-labelled-two-bar presentation of invented source observations. The pinned title is misleading; its description supports a narrow recording/presentation slice. No living-things classification key or independent field survey claim.

Construct exact numerical bars on a supplied shared 0–70 scale with 10-unit ticks, choose quantity/unit labels and compare two categories. Distinguish reading an inaccurate draft from source agreement and question relevance. No independent scale choice, pictogram, time-series graph or full-topic claim.
Repair a rectangular two-piece cut into equal halves; unequal widths remain editable and are not called halves.
Repair rectangular cuts into four equal-width quarters, distinguish equality from merely counting four pieces.
Partition only uniform rectangles into equal halves/quarters; circles and other shapes remain missing.
Manually step through supplied identical wholes showing one half and two quarters; compare learner-selected portions without independent equivalence assessment.
One or three quarters of a twelve-bun whole, using four supplied group mats. No general fraction-of-amount strategy or unlike whole comparison.
Make four equal groups of three from twelve identical tokens; pack one/three complete groups while retaining the original whole.
Reversible one-at-a-time/one-each bun sharing into four supplied mats. Grouping remains visible; full twelve-bun scope only.
A fixed 0–1 line and accumulation strip derive the amount of selected equal loaf pieces, including separated quarters. No independent marker placement or scale selection.

references.gameName: Rain Paths: follow a tabletop machine
references.scope: Identify the one supplied difference between matched tabletop machines: open versus sealed entrance, or starting stored tokens. Controls remain visible; no independent physical test planning/carrying-out.

references.gameName: Rain Paths: follow a tabletop machine
references.scope: Choose newly-stored/new-runoff columns relevant to where the new tokens went; keep exact supplied counts and copied route results. No real measurement, free data collection or graph construction.

references.gameName: Rain Paths: follow a tabletop machine
references.scope: Supplied prompts distinguish visible token counts from authored machine rules, with optional unrecorded conversation. No automatically checked causal explanation or real hydrologic evidence.

Use a supplied standard-unit mL scale, retain a numeric reading and compare exact fictional volumes. No capacity estimation, physical tools or other unit choice instruction beyond a finite mL/g/items contrast.
Read a straight-sided graduated 500 mL picture jug with ten 50 mL intervals, fill and reversibly transfer liquid portions. Other measures and independent practical measuring remain absent.
Compare each same-unit preparation amount with its recipe target and optionally inspect needed additions/returns. No conversions, mass or general multistep measure problems.
Read supplied creator/date/source-kind labels and distinguish object production date from an unestablished exact scene time. No independent archival sourcing or inferred creator motive.
Compare the scope of one period photo and a modern chronology, including what they cannot corroborate. These are not two independent eyewitness confirmations.
Finite contrasts separate visible local detail, catalogue date, modern summary and a limited peak-before-return inference. No full historical-argument or citywide conclusion.
Select the supplied photo, chronology or neither for a specific question, then choose evidence/limits for a prepared reply. No broad research proficiency or automatically evaluated original writing.

references.gameName: Rain Paths charts: a carried result
references.scope: Select and organise completed model counts relevant to a supplied runoff question. No new real measurement or independent data collection.

references.gameName: Rain Paths charts: a carried result
references.scope: Present carried machine counts as two labelled bars and compare the draft with its frozen source. No living-thing classification or full scientific presentation claim.

references.gameName: Rain Paths charts: a carried result
references.scope: Construct bars against a supplied four-token tick scale; distinguish reading the entered chart from source fidelity and compare two runoff counts. No independent scale choice, pictograms or broad graph proficiency.
Build and read a flag location on a fixed 0–2 length line. Supplied whole/scale and visible model; no independent scale selection or full fraction-number topic coverage.
Edit equal/unequal first-whole partitions, repeat those same spaces in the second whole and step only along actual boundaries. Fixed12-tick coordinate model, six authored cases.
Name an actual flag with whole or fraction notation, separating a correct location reading from the requested stop/partition. One five-quarter encounter; no general mixed-number or area/set work.
Keep a half-length route and compare a current two-quarter/three-sixth route at the same physical scale. Half family only, no general equivalence/simplification strategy.
Read/write bounded whole or numerator/denominator notation for an actual visible flag; equivalents accepted. No general symbolic fluency or independent reading proficiency inference.

Count thirteen pictured counters, move ten to a frame and wrap/unwrap the same ten with three outside; a separate supplied sixteen example revisits the action. Only these two teens, not all teen numerals or handwriting.

Wrap exactly ten frame counters into one visibly ten-marked bundle and unwrap into an empty ten-place frame. Fixed totals conserved with reversible one-counter moves; containers add no counters. No arbitrary packing capacity or physical exchange inference.

Distinguish actual wrapped bundles from a supplied numeral’s tens digit and tens-place value for selected quantities 0,7,13,20,27,30,42, including noncanonical grouping. Zero/seven have no written tens digit; empty tens place is supplied. No full two-digit range, independent decoding or written arithmetic claim.

Arrange up to three supplied actions in two fixed scenes, inspect missing/out-of-order consequences and manually reveal a computer’s finite rules. One note/envelope premise and one newcomer/preparation case; not general programming or arbitrary natural-language execution.

Make an independent picture plan, optionally rehearse off-screen, then explicitly assemble supplied sentences or write exact ungraded words. Plan and both drafts stay separate; no observed oral sentence production, independent prose or narrative beginning/middle/end claim.

Read an exact draft with a person, invite clarification, preserve a comment tied to that text and compare explicit versions. A guided opportunity; no automatic reader-comprehension, prose-quality, proofreading or learning judgment.

Name the reader’s knowledge and this note’s purpose; optionally compare a supplied preparation instruction with an invitation to watch, plus a newcomer/familiar-reader discussion. Supplied form/purpose contrast only; full tone/register/genre choice remains outside this slice.

Independently choose A/B height and surface settings for one of two supplied questions; explain whether neither, one relevant, one other or both factors change. Narrow finite-model design practice; no general physical experimental competence.

Choose which finite model trials to reveal, inspect a labelled A/B table and shared ruler, and notice unequal repetitions or observed variation. Automatic recording is supported data reading, not independent measurement or table construction.

Keep frozen stopping distances separate from a provisional claim and exact optional words, with a supplied explanation of what a confounded comparison cannot establish. Prose and physical causal reasoning remain ungraded.
Four labelled schematic US coins with supplied names/cent values and a size-versus-value contrast. US-cent adaptation only; source UK coins/notes and independent real-coin recognition are not met.

Construct two different US-cent coin vectors for one marked amount and exchange denominations while conserving value. Separate physical coin count from cents. The source description concerns combinations; giving change and UK-specific evidence remain outside this slice.
Read supplied horizontal-first ordered pairs and place labelled landmarks on intersections0–5. The grid/key are supplied; shape vertices and independent explanation remain unobserved.

Supplied perpendicular axes with origin(0,0), across-first/up-second coordinate labels and a(4,2) versus(2,4) talking invitation. The bundled generic title describes a coordinate system; no independent axis construction or wider attainment.
Author fictional landmark positions and interpret two route endpoints on a bounded first-quadrant point grid. No time/distance data graph, negative coordinates or physical map survey.

Count every travelled unit segment, including retracing, with1 fictional model metre per interval; distinguish six point markers from five intervals. No physical ruler or real-object measurement claim.

Compare two original fictional tellers with different access to one event. Noticing, time and visibility change available details; no first/third-person classification, authorial intent or general reliability attainment.

Classify supplied statements across both fictional accounts, combining authored supporting line sets. Distinguish inference, explicit contradiction and missing information; supplied selections do not establish independent reading or general evidence evaluation.

Choose between supplied revisions in response to a fictional reader’s specific question. Exact own words can be kept for a human reader but are ungraded; no claim of independent revision or broad writing-feedback proficiency.

Body clues (#living/bodies, local build): compare jointed walking legs plus a second feature on four supplied adult diagrams. Ladybird is a beetle; no universal six-leg converse, life-stage rule, spider practice, real field identification or whole-topic attainment.

Body clues (#living/bodies, local build): follow a supplied four-picture two-feature key, retain uncertainty and revise a trail. Not creating keys, identifying unfamiliar organisms outdoors, independent decoding or full evidence coverage.
